shell.title: AI document manager
shell.sampleHint: The company, people, tax IDs (NIT), amounts and documents are fictitious.

shell.serverLine: The documents you upload with your account: the server extracts the text, AI summarizes and tags them, and you can search them by meaning. Each account only sees its own.

how.title: What is real and what is simulated
real: Sample data: favorites, rename, move to a folder, create folders, trash, restore, delete permanently and reset. Saved in your browser.
Search in each document's name, tags and text, showing the matching snippet; filters by type, date and tag; sorting.
Rule-based clause detection with a risk level on the open contract's text; word-by-word comparison between versions.
Retention by folder: the keep-until date of each document is calculated, and legal hold blocks the trash.
Downloads generated in your browser: CSV inventory, audit package (CSV or JSON) and a watermarked PDF copy.
My documents (signed in): upload PDF, DOCX, TXT and CSV, AI summary and tags, search by meaning, “Explain with AI” and “Why this result?” on the server, with an AI spending cap.
sim: The construction company's 16 documents are fictitious; their summaries, keywords and explanations are written in advance (not generated live by AI).
The OCR reading of the scanned invoices is sample data: this demo does not process any image.
With sample data, “Search by meaning” widens the search with synonyms in your browser; it does not use AI.
Retention periods are illustrative and the rule only applies in this demo, not on the server.
tour: Search for “cláusula penal” (the documents are in Spanish) and look at the highlighted snippet on each card.
Open the works contract: click “Detect clauses” and then “Compare versions”.
Open a scanned invoice and click “View OCR reading”.
Turn on legal hold for “Contracts” (archive icon next to Folders) and try to move a contract to the trash.
Export the inventory or build an audit package; to upload your documents, go to “My documents”.
how.buildTitle: What we build in your project
build: Real OCR for scanned documents and reading of electronic invoices.
Intake by email, phone, Google Drive or SharePoint, and through an API.
Folder permissions, access auditing and your company's records retention schedule (TRD).
Connection to your RAG assistant to ask your documents questions and get answers with the source.
